cli.help.extra:
Environment Variables:
  # Core Providers
  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY - Anthropic Claude models
  ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN - Anthropic OAuth
  OPENAI_API_KEY - OpenAI GPT models
  GEMINI_API_KEY - Google Gemini models
  COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN - GitHub Copilot
  # Additional LLM Providers
  AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY - Azure OpenAI models
  GROQ_API_KEY - Groq models
  MISTRAL_API_KEY - Mistral models
  ZAI_API_KEY - z.ai models
  MINIMAX_API_KEY - MiniMax models
  # Cloud Providers
  AWS_PROFILE - AWS Bedrock
  GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT - Google Vertex AI
  # Search & Tools
  EXA_API_KEY - Exa web search
  BRAVE_API_KEY - Brave web search
  TAVILY_API_KEY - Tavily web search
  # Configuration
  OMP_PROFILE - Named profile for isolated agent state
  Use `omp --profile <name> --alias <command>` to create a shell shortcut for a profile
  PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR - Session storage directory (default: ~/{configDir}/agent)
  PI_NO_PTY - Disable PTY-based interactive bash execution
  For complete environment variable reference, see:
  docs/environment-variables.md
Available Tools (default-enabled unless noted):
  read - Read file contents
  bash - Execute bash commands
  edit - Edit files with find/replace
  write - Write files (creates/overwrites)
  grep - Search file contents
  glob - Find files by glob pattern
  lsp - Language server protocol
  python - Execute Python code (requires: {appName} setup python)
  browser - Browser automation
  task - Launch sub-agents
  todo - Manage todo/task lists
  web_search - Search the web
Plugin Options:
  --plugin-dir <path> Load plugin from directory (repeatable)
Useful Commands:
  omp agents unpack - Export bundled subagents
  omp agents unpack --project - Export bundled subagents

flags.idle-limit.description: Cap pauses between frames to this many seconds
flags.include-disabled.description: Import credentials whose JSON has `disabled: true` (import)
flags.include-env.description: Capture env-var API keys for providers not yet on broker (migrate)
flags.include-oauth.description: Also upload OAuth from local SQLite during migrate (default skips them)
flags.inPlace.description: Overwrite each source file with its approved text
flags.max-bytes.description: Maximum file size to scan in bytes; 0 disables the limit (ttsr scan)
flags.no-auth.description: Disable inbound bearer-token auth (serve). Useful when bound to loopback — any caller is allowed.
flags.no-extensions.description: Disable extension discovery (explicit -e paths still work)
flags.no-snapshot.description: Skip sourcing snapshot from user shell
flags.no-tui.description: Use the line-oriented console instead of the interactive TUI
flags.no-ui.description: With --mode rpc: run extensions headless (no extension_ui_request dialogs for the host)
flags.nya-max.description: Longest accepted cat sound in nya{1,N} (default: 8)
flags.package.description: Restrict a new token to a package (repeatable)
flags.prefill-bytes.description: Synthetic input size for prefill challenges (default: 32768, capped by the context window)
flags.repaint.description: Benchmark N extra full clear-scrollback repaints (the /tree navigation frame)
flags.retain-newest-global.description: Always keep this many newest sessions active
flags.retain-newest-per-cwd.description: Always keep this many newest sessions per cwd active
flags.rounds.description: Maximum drafts per file before giving up
flags.segment.description: Render a single status-line segment by name
flags.service-tier.description: Service tier applied per model family (default: configured `tier.*` settings; `none` omits it)
flags.stable.description: Switch back to the stable channel
flags.surface.description: Render only tool, composer, or segment surfaces (repeatable; default: all)
flags.system-prompt-template.description: Handlebars system prompt template (mutually exclusive with --system-prompt)
flags.tests.description: Also run configured project test suites
flags.timing.description: Print phase timings and emitted byte counts to stderr
flags.title.description: Stream title (defaults to the current directory name)
flags.turns.description: Maximum turns per model; turn N issues N actions (default: 24)
flags.view.description: Request a view-only link instead of control access (link only)
flags.yes.description: Install or update skills that ship scripts without asking
